svg.title: Both sessions read 10 before either wrote. One sale vanished.
svg.desc: Two session timelines under READ COMMITTED: A begins and reads stock 10, B reads 10 as well, then both write 9 and both commit, so the final stock is 9 after two sales — the overlap where both reads happen is boxed in red. Below, the same two sessions with SELECT FOR UPDATE: B stalls as a dashed waiting bar until A commits, then reads 9 and writes 8. A ladder of isolation levels and measured throughput on one hot row complete the picture.
svg.text: Both sessions read 10 before either wrote. One sale vanished.
READ COMMITTED, two buyers, one unit left
both read 10. Nothing is wrong YET.
two sales, one unit gone. No error, no warning.
the same two sessions, with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
B waits here - the row is locked
one hot row: RC 170.2 tps · FOR UPDATE 108.4 tps · SERIALIZABLE 60.7 tps
...now do it with 200 buyers at once
